svg.title: One decision cycle - from event to recommendation, rejection and learning

g.text: One decision cycle - from event to recommendation, rejection and learning
new incident INC_042 (Muret, 120 customers, est. 4 h)
warm start: insert INC_042 into previous plan (< 10 ms)
local search on full objective (200-500 ms)
check every number exists in the facts
fin de poste dans 6 h. Équipe 4 coûterait +410 clients·h."
reject: "la route de Muret est inondée jusqu'à 18h"
new plan + cost of the rule: +320 clients·h (+2 %)
repair done INC_031 - actual 6 h (estimated 4 h)
calibration: repairs run +30 % in this zone today
corrected estimates for pending incidents → re-plan
4. Between crises: the system proposes improvements
all decisions, reasons, chosen vs rejected plans
preference fit: β, λ from chosen vs rejected plans
